remarks: Welcome to this beautiful, move-in-ready, three-story END UNIT townhome-style condominium in the desirable Village Walk Community of San Dimas! Built in 2013, this spacious residence offers 3 bedrooms, 2 full bathrooms, 2 half bathrooms, and approximately 1,754 square feet of comfortable living space. As an end unit, the home enjoys abundant natural light through multiple windows, creating a bright and inviting atmosphere. The thoughtfully designed interior features elegant engineered wood flooring, recessed lighting, fresh interior paint throughout, and neutral tones.
